overview: The Community Development Board elected its officers, voted to recommend deleting an obsolete zoning ordinance section on vacant properties, and reviewed a draft RFP for a new multi-year zoning consultant.

items.title: Election of Officers and CPC Representative
items.summary: The board elected Doug Carr as chair, Dina Caloggero as vice chair, and Paige Buldini as the board's representative to the Community Preservation Committee.

items.title: Vacant and Foreclosing Properties Zoning Ordinance Amendment
items.summary: The board closed the public hearing and voted to recommend deleting Section 94-7.5, with the deletion to take effect concurrently with the effective date of the new general ordinance under Chapter 10, Article 8.

items.title: Zoning Consultant RFP
items.summary: The board reviewed and discussed a draft Request for Proposals (RFP) for a multi-year zoning consultant contract, providing feedback on public engagement tracking, a cover summary for proposed legislation, and geographic priorities.

items.title: Zoning Project and Administrative Updates
items.summary: Board members expressed disappointment regarding the City Council's late changes to the Boston Avenue zoning district, while staff provided updates on upcoming developments and internal personnel changes.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The board approved the meeting minutes from August 12, 2026.
